issues.description: The problem statement and the template refer to the framebuffer start as 'display_start', but the solution's .bss section defines the buffer as 'screen_buffer'. This names the same conceptual entity (start of the screen/display memory) differently across artifacts. Additionally, the solution code still references 'display_start' in instructions (e.g. add eax, display_start and mov esi, display_start) while its .bss defines 'screen_buffer', which is inconsistent and likely to confuse students and may cause build/link errors. This mismatch makes it harder for students to map the problem description to the provided solution and template.
issues.suggested_fix: Use a single consistent identifier for the framebuffer base across all artifacts. Recommended: rename the solution .bss symbol 'screen_buffer' to 'display_start' (i.e., change 'screen_buffer RESB 8294400' to 'display_start RESB 8294400'), or alternatively update all code references to 'screen_buffer' and the problem/template text to match. Prefer aligning the solution to 'display_start' to match the problem statement and the template.
